display_name: The regiment's two-digit commands on the ASPD-U (IT-45)
status: Code table for simcore/command_post.hpp (RegimentCommand, AspdCodeTable): what each two-digit command the regiment's post sends by telecode means, and what the battery does on it. Proposal 5 of docs/research/PLOTTING_BOARD_2026-10.md.
notes: That the ASPD-U carries commands and reports as two-digit decimals and shows them on the tube is documented (rwd_mb3 pu12; flak11 PU12-0). The table of codes itself has not been found: the codes and their meanings are SAM3D's placeholders, chosen to cover the commands an air-defence regiment gives a battery (readiness, fire ban and permission, cease fire, friendly aircraft in the zone).
source: rwd_mb3 (pu12: Übertragung und Empfang von Kommandos und Meldungen sowie deren Darstellung auf dem Sichtgerät in Form von Dezimalzahlen); flak11 (PU12-0: Kommandos oder Meldungen in Form zweistelliger Ziffern); the code values are a sam3d placeholder

codes.notes: The battery to full readiness: the launchers up and manned.
